errors.text_span: the gray “Standard” segment extends from about 48 up to roughly 51–52 (≈51.5)
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes how to read the value of the bar. The y-axis begins at 48, but this is not the base of the bar. The bar's value is its height from the zero baseline, which is approximately 51.5. The description implies the value is the difference (51.5 - 48 = 3.5), which is incorrect.
